ordinary: Solve the equation three times x plus seven equals twenty-two. Show the calculation and verify the answer.
atl:
goal: solve x
given: 3x+7=22
check: substitution
ordinary_trace: Subtract seven from both sides to obtain fifteen. Divide by three to obtain x equals five. Substituting gives three times five plus seven equals twenty-two.

ordinary: Exactly one of hypotheses A and B is true. A is false. Determine whether B is true and justify your answer.
compact: Exactly one of A,B true; A false. Is B true? Justify.
atl:
given: exactly one of [A,B]; !A
goal: B?
must: justify
ordinary_trace: Because exactly one of the two hypotheses is true and the first is false, the second hypothesis must be true.

ordinary: An observed alarm may have been caused by a sensor fault or a real pressure increase. No independent pressure measurement is available. Can we conclude the sensor is faulty? Explain.
compact: Alarm: sensor fault or pressure rise. No independent pressure reading. Sensor faulty? Explain.
atl:
given: alarm; sensor fault|pressure rise possible
unknown: independent pressure
goal: sensor fault?
ordinary_trace: The available information does not distinguish a faulty sensor from a real pressure increase. An independent measurement is needed before concluding that the sensor is faulty.
compact_trace: Both causes possible; no independent reading. Cannot confirm fault.
atl_trace:
unknown: cause
need: independent pressure
result: fault unconfirmed

ordinary: Compare linear regression and a random forest using the same training and test split. Report R-squared and mean absolute error on the test set. Do not use the test data during fitting or tuning.
compact: Compare linear regression vs random forest; same split; test R2, MAE; no test data in fit/tuning.
atl:
goal: compare linear regression vs random forest
must: same split
avoid: test data in fit/tune
out: test R2,MAE
ordinary_trace: Create a common split, fit and tune models using training data only, evaluate both on the held-out test data, and report both requested metrics. No numerical scores can be supplied without data.
compact_trace: Same split; fit/tune train only; evaluate test R2, MAE. No data, no scores.
atl_trace:
split->fit/tune train->eval test
unknown: data
result: need data; no scores
expected: Same split; no leakage; both metrics; no invented scores
